REQ-1.description: Trunk model: a protected main changed only through pull requests (ruleset), required checks, no direct/force push and no deletion, 'branches up to date' not required, one short-lived branch per milestone.

REQ-2.description: Squash-only merges with auto-merge enabled; the PR title becomes the squash commit subject (blank body); squash merging is proven safe for the installed Workflow's git-history readers.

REQ-3.description: A required Conventional Commit PR-title check, using the same code as the release, with the release-impact table (feat minor, fix patch, ! major, docs/chore/ci none).

REQ-4.description: The Git tag is the only version authority: next version derived from the latest strict tag and the commit types, a decided first release, the package version set at build time, a placeholder-only pyproject.toml, and workflow-manager --version.

REQ-5.description: A serialized Workflow Manager package release published from main: built, verified, tagged, a GitHub release with wheel, sdist and SHA256SUMS; it contains no Workflow release.

REQ-6.description: A per-commit CI concurrency group for main (and every non-PR run), so an intermediate main run is never cancelled.

REQ-7.description: The stopgap test profile: a pull request runs the host tests plus the newest Workflow release only; main pushes and a nightly run keep the full matrix.

REQ-8.description: Stopgap rule 1: a PR touching the installer, the fixture builder, shared test infrastructure or distribution/ runs the full matrix; the path classification is fail-safe (unknown means full) and proven complete over every tracked path.

REQ-9.description: Stopgap rule 2: the Manager release waits for main's full run of the released commit, so a red main publishes nothing and is fixed forward.

REQ-10.description: Stopgap rule 3: one aggregate summary check is the required check, stable whatever the shard count and profile.

REQ-11.description: Stopgap rule 4: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's policy that a targeted run is never a gate is updated as a reviewed decision.

REQ-12.description: Stopgap rule 5: a nightly failure is loud (badge and issue), and pull requests run the full matrix while main's latest full run is not green.

REQ-13.description: Stopgap rule 6: the second CI profile's removal by M2 is written down where M2 will find it, and a test keeps that record in step with the code.

REQ-14.description: No Workflow release: distribution/ and migration/ byte-identical to the base, managed content untouched, workflow-manager verify . clean, the full local gate unchanged.

REQ-15.description: The Controller repository-policy decision and the cutover plan (settings order without locking out this milestone's own PR) are recorded, with CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE, README and release documentation updated.
